title: Self-Directed Actions and Poses (-kodik/-kedik)
grammar: Behavioral and reflexive-middle verbs with -kodik/-kedik/-ködik and -ódik/-ődik
goal: I can form and interpret behavioral and self-directed verbs ending in -kodik/-kedik/-ködik
I can use inner-brooding verbs such as tépelődik, kételkedik, and aggodalmaskodik with their governed cases
I can distinguish genuine emotion from outward posturing in psychological narration
